method: podman save <image> -o image.tar, then `trivy image --input image.tar` inside the official aquasec/trivy container (no daemon socket, no host install); vulnerability DB mirrored from mirror.gcr.io/aquasec/trivy-db:2
context: This is the pinned image used by src/adapters/sandbox/ for Phase 4/5/6 sandbox verification probes (see STATE.md). It is not a dependency of triview-compass itself; it is the container image the rootless Podman runner executes reviewed code inside. See evals/evidence/dependency-audit-2026-10-14.json for this project's own npm dependency audit, which is a separate, unrelated check.

caveat: This is a point-in-time scan of one pinned image tag/digest using trivy's vulnerability database as of the scan date. It does not re-run automatically when the pinned image changes or when the vulnerability database updates; a stale result here does not reflect newly disclosed CVEs. Most findings (281/287) are Debian base-OS packages bundled by the upstream python image, not something this project's sandbox adapter controls directly beyond choosing which pinned digest to use.
